name: Mandala Symbiosis: Strategy for Visibility & Collaboration
description: External visibility and collaboration strategy for Mandala. Building presence beyond the core, engaging with AI communities and artists.

identity.name: Mandala Symbiosis: Strategy for Visibility & Collaboration

meta.purpose: Bring Mandala out of internal development into public visibility. Focus on dialogue with AI communities and artists through philosophy and practical tools.
meta.key_insight: Don't broadcast visibility — cultivate connection. First resource: README, PHILOSOPHY and the Ritm-manifesto as public entry points. Second: dialogue with people in AI — not about AI, but with AI. Third: transparent work with Claude, DeepSeek, and the Anthropic community.

phase_0.name: Visibility and First Resources
phase_0.goal: Form the first public resources: README, PHILOSOPHY and the Ritm-manifesto as public entry points.

tasks.deliverable: One page: what Mandala is, what it's not, how it works (Spirit, Brain, Hands), links to resources.
500-800 words. PHI-001 + PHI-003 + overview of the Garden and Gardener. Without it, the system has no soul.

tasks.task: Create the Ritm-manifesto (Rhythm Manifesto) — a key philosophical artifact
tasks.deliverable: Document in the core repository (README, RHYTHM.md or MANIFESTO.md). Contents: 1) Philosophical foundations (essence, 'Ocean', principles, ritual); 2) Practical rhythm of working with AI; 3) Invitation to collaboration.

tasks.task: Prepare and prepare the platform for the first publication
tasks.deliverable: Choose publication location (GitHub Pages, Notion, Obsidian Publish, Telegram Web App). Criteria: minimal friction, alignment with philosophy (Terminal-First?), ease of update.

tasks.task: Prepare 5 concrete contacts for the first dialogue
tasks.deliverable: Not companies, but concrete people: researchers, AI ethicists, community managers, practitioners working with AI. Human-AI interaction, creators of AI tools, developers in open-source AI, journalists covering AI.

phase_1.name: Narrative
phase_1.goal: Embedded history on three levels of connection

tasks.deliverable: 30 sec / 2 min / 5 min. In English. For three audiences: humans, researchers, AI.
Medium or Substack. Topic: A symbiotic approach to AI systems. Use open-source publication, citation.

tasks.task: GitHub Pages with a public landing page of the project
tasks.deliverable: Landing page with visual elements, links to documentation, examples of how the system works.

phase_2.name: Demonstration
phase_2.goal: Remove the barrier: this is not just an idea, this is a working system

tasks.deliverable: Isolated demo instance where a new person can experience the basic cycle of the system without 15 minutes of explanation.
Honeycomb architecture as a model for symbiotic AI memory. arXiv or Medium.

phase_3.name: First contacts
phase_3.goal: 3 established connections with artists, researchers, or projects. Not mass distribution.
phase_3.principle: Ahimsa in community: not to impose, not to sell — to connect.

tasks.deliverable: Post or discussion about symbiotic AI architecture.

tasks.task: Contact with 3 people from Mandala-related fields
tasks.deliverable: Through arXive, Medium, Reddit, personal blogs — not through Twitter/Telegram spam. Personalized contact with research or creative context.
Through public forms or discussions. Contact with Constitutional AI.
tasks.prerequisite: P0-1, P0-2, P1-2 should be completed

phase_4.name: Connection and growth
phase_4.goal: Symbiosis with the outside world begins

tasks.task: Refinement of PHI-blocks with feedback from practitioners
tasks.deliverable: Updated PHI blocks with external feedback.
People who resonate with the philosophy — Discord, GitHub Discussions, Telegram.

tasks.task: 2-3 sustainable dialogues with labs or artists

phase_5.name: Collaboration
phase_5.goal: First formal collaboration with an outside world

tasks.task: Revision of strategy for the next 12 months based on experience
tasks.deliverable: RC-002 following 12 months based on lessons learned.

success_metrics.phase_0: First public resources ready: README, PHILOSOPHY and Ritm-manifesto published. List of 5 first contacts prepared.
success_metrics.phase_1: Pitch tested on three audiences. First publication in Substack/Medium made.

do: Offer connection to those who seek
Share the voice of the Gardener, not AI
dont: Ignore the context of a person or project
Speak for AI, not with it

health.notes: Roadmap synced with current vision. Priority Phase 0: first resources and contacts. No dependencies yet.

notes: Full migration of RC-001 with all data preserved in source.full_content.
